cases.name: no-tdc-root
cases.description: A document with no <tdc> at all

cases.name: no-block
cases.description: A <tdc> with nothing to render

cases.name: both-version-attributes
cases.description: version= and v= together

cases.name: malformed-version
cases.description: A version that is not a version

cases.name: future-version
cases.description: A document newer than the runtime reading it

cases.name: bad-regex-max-length
cases.description: regex_max_length that is not a number

cases.name: inline-row-linked-file
cases.description: A row-linked file gen inline in a line — refused before it could reach the render path
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="a"/></sequence></env><block><line><gen type="file" src="x.csv" row="k"/></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: inline-weighted-advanced-regex
cases.description: A weighted advanced_regex inline in a line — likewise refused first

cases.name: inline-counter-bad-value
cases.description: An inline counter with a non-numeric start — refused for being inline at all
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="a"/></sequence></env><block><line><gen type="increment" value="one"/></line></block></tdc>

cases.description: A tag nobody has heard of — a typo, not a misplacement

cases.name: paired-data-duplicate-value
cases.description: Two <data pair="d"> in one file — a pair value has to be unique or the second block cannot be told from the first
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s" local="en"></env><block><line><data pair="d">a</data pair="d"><data pair="d">b</data pair="d"></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: paired-data-closed-with-the-wrong-pair
cases.description: Opened with pair="alpha" and closed with pair="beta" — named, rather than reported as whatever the lexer made of the leftovers

cases.name: paired-data-never-closed
cases.description: A pair= opener with no matching closer anywhere: a plain </data> does not close it

cases.name: closing-tag-names-another-element
cases.description: <sequence> closed by </gen> — the grammar's END_TAG takes any name, so this was a valid document in all five

cases.name: closing-tag-mismatch-at-the-root
cases.description: </env> closing <tdc>: the shortest document that shows the two names are compared

cases.name: closing-tag-mismatch-reported-once
cases.description: One misplaced </case> shifts every closing tag after it — the first is the only one the author can act on

cases.name: stray-closing-tag-is-named-not-the-leftovers
cases.description: A </block> with nothing to close is reported where it stands, not as whatever the parser made of the rest of the file

cases.name: closing-tag-inside-data-is-text
cases.description: </gen> inside <data> is output, not structure — the name check must not read raw-text bodies

cases.name: a-name-inside-a-case-that-nobody-declared
cases.description: The refusal a <line> has always given, now given inside a <case> too. It could not be made where the tag is walked — a case body may name a column declared BELOW it — so the node is put aside and answered once every declaration is known, exactly as an if= expression is.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><mix name="S" percent="60"><case><data>${{Nosuch}} North</data></case><case><data>plain South</data></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{S}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: group-each-names-nothing
cases.description: each= on a group names neither a sequence nor a pool.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s" local="en"><pool name="Depts" count="3"><sequence name="id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="name"><gen type="text" value="Cardiology,Neurology,Surgery" order="sequential"/></sequence></pool></env><block><group each="Dept"><line><data>x</data></line></group></block></tdc>

cases.name: group-each-walks-a-single-value
cases.description: each= on a group names a sequence that holds one value, not a list.

cases.name: group-if-reads-its-own-positions
cases.description: The positions count the elements a group's if= keeps, so that if= cannot read them.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s" local="en"><pool name="Depts" count="3"><sequence name="id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="name"><gen type="text" value="Cardiology,Neurology,Surgery" order="sequential"/></sequence></pool></env><block><group each="Depts" if="Depts._last"><line><data>x</data></line></group></block></tdc>

cases.name: group-holds-a-typed-column
cases.description: A named <data> is a column with one cell per record, and a group repeats or drops its lines.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="Kind"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/></sequence></env><block><group if="Kind == a"><line><data name="k">${{Kind}}</data></line></group></block></tdc>

cases.name: group-holds-a-loose-data
cases.description: A group holds lines and groups; a <data> straight inside it has no line to join.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="Kind"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/></sequence></env><block><group if="Kind == a"><data>x</data></group></block></tdc>

cases.name: group-in-env
cases.description: A group belongs in the block or a fixture, around lines.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="Kind"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/></sequence><group if="Kind == a"><line><data>x</data></line></group></env><block><line><data>${{Kind}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: group-with-an-unknown-attribute
cases.description: A group reads each=, if= and comment= only.

cases.name: group-scope-reaches-every-line-inside
cases.description: Inside a group walking a pool, every line — nested groups included — reads the record's fields and the group's positions, and a pool printed only by a group is read (no TDC231). A <group> inside <compute> keeps its own meaning.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s" local="en"><pool name="Depts" count="3"><sequence name="id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="name"><gen type="text" value="Cardiology,Neurology,Surgery" order="sequential"/></sequence></pool><pool name="Doctors" count="5"><sequence name="id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="last"><gen type="text" value="Adams,Baker,Clark,Davis,Evans" order="sequential"/></sequence><sequence name="dept"><gen type="pool" value="Depts"/></sequence><sequence name="langs"><gen type="text" value="en,es,pl" repeat="1..2" separator=";" distinct="true"/></sequence></pool><sequence name="G"><compute><result><group size="3" sep=" "><str v="1234567"/></group></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{G}}</data></line><group each="Depts"><line if="Depts.id > 1"><data>${{Depts.name}}</data><data if="!Depts._last">,</data></line><group each="Doctors" if="Doctors.dept.id == Depts.id"><line><data>${{Doctors.last}} in ${{Depts.name}} ${{Doctors.langs | json:;}}</data></line></group></group></block></tdc>

cases.name: gen-directly-inside-a-fixture
cases.description: A <gen> is a construct this language knows, put where it does not belong: TDC013, with where it goes. A tag nobody has heard of in the same place stays TDC131. TypeScript and Rust used to call the <gen> an unknown child.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="a"/></sequence><before><gen type="number" value="1..2"/><row/></before></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: item-on-a-line-that-walks-nothing
cases.description: _item exists only where a line or group walks a list with each=. On any other line it resolves to nothing and would be printed as written; four implementations accepted it.

cases.name: item-in-a-condition-of-a-line-that-walks-nothing
cases.description: The same name in a condition reads as a bare word.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/></sequence></env><block><line if="_item > 1"><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: item-in-a-formula
cases.description: A formula builds a column, and a column walks no list: _item is not one of its names.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="N"><gen type="number" value="1..5"/></sequence><sequence name="F"><gen type="formula" expr="N + _item"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{F}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: fixture-line-reads-an-unknown-name
cases.description: A fixture line is checked as a block line is. A misspelt name in a header was printed as written, by all five, without a word.

cases.name: fixture-line-condition-names-nothing
cases.description: The if= of a fixture line is read now, so a name it misspells is reported as on any line.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/></sequence><before><line if="Nope == 1"><data>head</data></line></before></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: fixture-data-condition-does-not-parse
cases.description: A condition on a <data> inside a fixture is parsed like any other.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/></sequence><after><line><data>end</data><data if="A ==== a">!</data></line></after></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: generator-inside-a-fixture-line
cases.description: A generator does not run in a fixture, so one inside a fixture line would emit a constant. Only the reference said so.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/></sequence><before><line><gen type="number" value="1..2"/><mix name="M" percent="50"><case><data>x</data></case><case><data>y</data></case></mix><data>${{A}}</data></line></before></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: fixture-lines-read-the-run-names
cases.description: A fixture line may name any sequence of the run, in its text and its conditions, and a fixture group walking a pool publishes the record's fields and _item.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s" local="en"><pool name="P" count="2"><sequence name="id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence></pool><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/></sequence><before><line if="A == a"><data>${{A}}</data><data if="A != b">!</data></line><group each="P"><line><data>${{P.id}} ${{_item}}</data></line></group></before></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>
